title: Denis Taxi · Airport and City · English Friendly · 336
style: upbeat latino pop, 100 BPM, light percussion, marimba and acoustic guitar, female Spanish vocal and male English vocal alternating, airport pickup vibe, helpful and clear tone, welcoming first-time visitors to Nicaragua, shaker and light cajon, no rap, no edm, no auto-tune, polished, bright daytime energy
lyrics:
[Intro]
¿Llegando al aeropuerto? Arriving at the airport?

[Verse 1]
(ES) Denis lo busca con su nombre.
(EN) Denis picks you up with your name.
(ES) Sin estrés, sin sorpresas.
(EN) No stress, no surprises.
(ES) Precio acordado antes de salir.
(EN) Price agreed before we leave.

[Verse 2]
(ES) Habla inglés, conoce la ciudad.
(EN) Speaks English, knows the city.
(ES) Le recomienda dónde comer.
(EN) Recommends where to eat.
(ES) Le cuida como familia.
(EN) Takes care of you like family.

[Chorus]
Denis. WhatsApp ahora. WhatsApp now.
Cinco cero cinco. Cinco ocho cero siete. Tres uno cuatro seis.
Shop Friend English House Sitting Pay For Coffee.
Just text. Estamos listos.

[Outro]
Bienvenidos a Nicaragua. Welcome home. Tres tres seis.
